g.text: Synthetic 192 × 192 px frame, unit Gaussian noise, 90 stars (PSF σ = 1.3 px) and a 64 px streak. Stars masked above 6σ after PSF smoothing.
(c) 60 trials per point on 128 px frames with stars masked; thresholds set from 240 empty frames for 0.1 false alarm per frame.
